sentences.text: Belen Garijo Lopez was appointed chief executive of Sanofi in February 2026, becoming the company's first female leader after the abrupt ouster of Paul Hudson, CEO since 2019, whose large increase in research spending failed to deliver rapid results.

She had served as CEO and Chair of the Executive Board of Merck KGaA since 2021, and her appointment marks a return to Sanofi, where she previously spent 15 years leading the integration of Genzyme after its acquisition, serving as VP of Pharmaceutical Operations for Europe and Canada, and sitting on the Executive Committee; earlier in her career she worked in R&D at Abbott Laboratories.

sentences.quote: Garijo's priority will be to "strengthen the productivity, governance, and innovation capacity of R&D."
sentences.text: Sanofi said her priority will be to strengthen the productivity, governance and innovation capacity of R&D. Sanofi shares fell nearly 6% on the announcement, with some analysts citing her relatively low profile.
